# Bloxwap Icons

A curated vector icon catalog for React, React Native, and SVG.
The UI package is in packages/icons. Brand and token images are in assets.
Install @bloxwap/icons@0.1.0 from npm. React, React Native, Pro chart icons, and SVGs ship in one package.

## Documentation
- [Overview](https://bloxwap.github.io/icons/docs/)
- [Getting started](https://bloxwap.github.io/icons/docs/getting-started/)
- [React](https://bloxwap.github.io/icons/docs/react/)
- [React Native](https://bloxwap.github.io/icons/docs/react-native/)
- [Accessibility](https://bloxwap.github.io/icons/docs/accessibility/)
- [Assets and SVG](https://bloxwap.github.io/icons/docs/assets/)

## Source
- [Repository](https://github.com/bloxwap/icons)
- [UI package](https://github.com/bloxwap/icons/tree/v2/packages/icons)

The gallery is limited to the Bloxwap monorepo usage inventory and Pro chart SVG collection.
Interface artwork derives from Lucide; chart artwork is from Bloxwap Chart (MIT). Preserve LICENSE and NOTICE when redistributing it.
Third-party brand marks remain the property of their respective owners.
